objective: Preregister 20 candidates (8 primary option-expiration-week calendar candidates + 12 internal placebo controls) for a batch screening lane to test against K1/K2 (primary only) plus a placebo internal-falsification rule. No backtest is run in this round.

keep_rule.K1: date-neutral Sharpe (D freq, single version) >= 0.80 * S3's date-neutral Sharpe in BOTH windows (anchor >=1.19, stress >=0.65), 10bp per side, positive CAGR at 20bp. Primary candidates only.
keep_rule.K2: a 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend of the candidate with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in BOTH windows. Primary candidates only.
keep_rule.watch_recent: anchor-window date-neutral Sharpe >= 1.19 but stress does not clear its bar -- forward-tracked only. Primary candidates only.
keep_rule.strong_keep: K2 edge >= 0.10 in both windows, or K1's Sharpe in both windows is >= S3's own (1.49 anchor / 0.81 stress).
keep_rule.placebo_internal_falsification: a primary candidate otherwise kept/strong/watch_recent is demoted to not_kept if any same-ticker placebo's anchor Sharpe >= that primary's own WEEK-variant anchor Sharpe.
keep_rule.pass_requires: K1 OR K2, primary candidates only, subject to placebo demotion.
keep_rule.multiple_comparisons: 20 candidates (8 primary + 12 placebo); report all regardless of outcome; DSR with n_trials=20 for any that pass.
